title: Phase retrieval from a uniformly discrete point set
summary: We prove that for every window $w$ of the form $w(x) = e^{-π|x|^2} h(x)$, where $h$ is a polynomial, there exists a uniformly discrete set of points $\mathcal{S} \subset \mathbb R^{2d}$ such that the magnitude of the short-time Fourier transform $V_w f$ on $\mathcal{S}$ determines every $f \in L^2(\mathbb R^d)$ up to a constant phase factor. The separation distance can be chosen independent of the degree of $h$ and proportional to the square root of the dimension.
